failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — `review_state` ends `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` when any lens carries an error. The witness drives an errored lens alone and beside a clean lens. It also drives it beside an anchored blocker and beside an anchored concern, each once before it and once after it. Each case keeps its line naming the errored lens and saying the review is incomplete. With no errored lens, a review with no findings and one with a concern still end `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, and one with a blocker still ends `REBUTTING`.

payload.summary: 1 of 2 criteria have no passing witness
